messages:
Deborah: Quick announce: on Thursday (2026-06-10) we're changing how we surface rate-limit metadata and a small billing behavior tweak for hosted free-tier accounts. Please skim and flag concerns.

Deborah: Changes: 1) response headers will include X-Quota-State and X-Quota-Remaining so clients can adapt; 2) free-tier now has a 48h soft-grace followed by immediate throttling unless customer upgrades; 3) invoice CSV adds normalized usage_code. Full notes: https://docs.redwood.example/billing/2026-rate-limit-headers

Cameron: For free-tier, is the 48h soft-grace new? Are we migrating anyone off older credit grants?

Deborah: Yes it's new. Existing legacy promo credits are not automatically removed but will stop covering usage after a 30-day transition window. Impacted customers will get an email and a migration credit.

Ryan: Runtime will emit headers and a new log event: quota.change with state. We'll gate behind a rollout flag and monitor 429 spikes. Sample headers: ````
X-Quota-State: soft
X-Quota-Remaining: 15
````

SupportBot: Support canned reply prepared and scheduled to send for accounts hitting new soft-grace limit. Template: https://internal.redwood/support/templates/rate-limit-softgrace.txt

Deborah: Action items: Eng (Ryan) flip flag Thu AM; Support to watch tickets and use tag billing-rate-headers; Product to send customer notice 7 days prior.

Cameron: Thanks. Please ping #customer-success when emails go out so CS can prep replies.

Deborah: Will do.
